messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — I'm opening a small Terraform change to add an H100 node pool for inference workloads. Plan: reserved capacity in primary region + spot fallback in secondary AZ, tainted for gpus=inference. PTAL before I create the PR.

Maria Chen: Terraform snippet I'm proposing:
```hcl
resource "r_infra_node_pool" "h100_inference" {
  name            = "np-h100-inference"
  instance_type   = "h100-48gb"
  size_min        = 2
  size_max        = 40
  reserved_count  = 8         # capacity reservation in us-west1
  spot_fallback   = true
  taints = { "gpus" = "inference:NoSchedule" }
  labels = { "node.kubernetes.io/instance-type" = "h100" }
}
```

Josh Patel: Quick Q — are we planning to bundle the NVIDIA driver in the node image or install via DaemonSet? if reserved nodes have custom image, secret wiring differs.

Maria Chen: Good call. For now we'll use our curated image (includes driver) for reserved nodes and DaemonSet for spot fallback. I'll add a variable `use_custom_image` so we can flip.

Vivek Ramesh: Also: how are we handling the license/driver credentials? we can't store binary creds in k8s secrets plain. Suggest SOPS-encrypted tfvars + KMS key + mount to daemonset via CSI driver.

Maria Chen: Agreed. Plan: SOPS for terraform tfvars (kms key arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01), and for the daemonset we'll create a K8s secret from SOPS output in the pipeline and mount via CSI. I'll add a note in the PR.

Elaine Wu: Node placement: can we make reserved nodes `node.kubernetes.io/zone=us-west1-a` affinity? We don't want reserved capacity spread across AZs because billing is per AZ. But we should allow spot in other AZs.

Maria Chen: Yup — setting `topology` param in tf module: reserved_zone = "us-west1-a", spot_zones = ["us-west1-b", "us-west1-c"]. Will include autoscaler annotations: `cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/safe-to-evict=false` for reserved workloads.

Josh Patel: For kubelet flags — make sure `--serialize-image-pulls=false` on GPU nodes? we had issues where large images block startup. Also add `--pods-per-core` tweak for high-GPU pods.

Maria Chen: Good catches. I'll add kubelet config in the node template.

Vivek Ramesh: One more: CI pipeline should run `terraform plan` and then a quick `k8s dry-run` of the daemonset + taints. We should gate apply on a manual approval for first rollouts.

Maria Chen: Will do. Draft PR will include:
- terraform change (module vars + reserved/spot split)
- kubelet config snippet
- daemonset SOPS integration docs
- rollout/runbook for ops (canary to two pods, healthcheck thresholds)

infra-bot: Preflight check results for branch `feature/h100-pool`:
- terraform fmt: OK
- tf validate: OK
- tfsec: 2 low findings (doc only)
- cluster dry-run: OK

Elaine Wu: Sounds good to me. Approving for PR creation. :thumbsup:

Josh Patel: lgtm, leave a note about billing alert for reserved usage spikes.

Vivek Ramesh: lgtm, and add a small monitor for driver installation failures (daemonset pod restarts).

Maria Chen: Thanks all — I'll create the PR with the snippets and tag infra-oncall for a canary apply. Will include explicit sops instructions:
```bash
# decrypt tfvars locally
sops --decrypt secrets/tfvars/h100.tfvars.enc > h100.tfvars
terraform plan -var-file=h100.tfvars
```

Maria Chen: pinging back when PR is up.

Josh Patel: thx!

Elaine Wu: nice one :rocket:
